name: lucas-academy-bible
description: Bible Sequence — a scripture memorization game for Lucas Academy

scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.build:itch: tsc -b && VITE_DIST_TARGET=itch vite build --base=./ --outDir dist-itch && node scripts/strip_itch_assets.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && node scripts/sync_ios_version.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:icon: qlmanage -t -s 1024 -o assets assets/logo.svg >/dev/null && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i assets/logo.svg.png -vf format=rgb24 -frames:v 1 assets/logo.png && rm assets/logo.svg.png && capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#f6efe0' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#16233b' --splashBackgroundColor '#f6efe0' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#16233b'
scripts.package:itch: npm run build:itch && cd dist-itch && zip -FSrq ../lucas-academy-bible-itch.zip .
